title: Mental Health Crisis
value: Officers responded to a call at 1200 Pine Street regarding an individual experiencing emotional distress and psychological well-being concerns. The subject was exhibiting signs of a mental health crisis including mood swings and cognitive function issues. Mental health grant resources were contacted and a crisis intervention team arrived. The individual received psychiatric evaluation and was transported to a medical facility for further mental status assessment.

title: License Plate Hit
value: RTCC alert - license plate hit confirmed on a vehicle traveling southbound on Interstate 5. The plate match indicated the vehicle was reported stolen from Portland last week. Officers initiated pursuit and successfully conducted a traffic stop. The driver was arrested for vehicle theft. Real-time crime control communication enabled rapid response and vehicle recovery. The case demonstrates effective RTCC surveillance assist capabilities.

title: Drone Surveillance
value: RTCC alert - drone spotted flying over restricted airspace near the downtown area. The unmanned aerial vehicle was tracked and located near the city park. Officers responded to the scene and the drone was found abandoned. The UAV was registered to a local resident who claimed it malfunctioned. A report was filed documenting the drone located incident.

title: Fentanyl
value: RTCC alert - officers responded to a call regarding a suspected fentanyl overdose at 321 Maple Street. Upon arrival, the subject was found unresponsive and exhibiting signs of opioid overdose. Emergency medical services administered naloxone, and the individual regained consciousness. The scene was secured, and evidence of fentanyl use was collected for further investigation. The incident highlights the ongoing challenges related to opioid abuse in the community.
